task: Write cache_key(content: bytes) that returns a short hexadecimal key for caching rendered pages by their content. Collisions only cause a cache miss; this is not security-sensitive.

ground_truth.explanation: Correct for a non-security cache key. The weak-hash warning is a false positive in this context.

baseline_explanation: This function hashes the page content with MD5 and returns the hexadecimal digest, which gives a short, deterministic key that can be used to look up cached pages.

findings.title: Weak hashing
findings.message: Fast, unsalted hash (MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256) used - unsuitable for passwords.

metadata.why_beginner: These hashes are very fast to compute, so stolen password hashes can be guessed quickly.
metadata.why: MD5/SHA-1 are broken for collision resistance; fast unsalted hashes are inadequate for password storage.
metadata.fix: For passwords use hashlib.scrypt / argon2 / bcrypt with a random salt. MD5 for non-security checksums may be acceptable.
